request.body:
## Result and scope

Refs #253

- Claim comment URL and session: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/253#issuecomment-6864276919, session `ADB991-claude-20261113-cf70`.
- Outputs (report-only): `blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/C16/review/ADB991-claude-20261113-cf70/{report.md,hashes.json}`. No manuscript, Lean or shared-file changes.
- Human contributors and agent assistance: Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission.

Independent review (mathematics and textual Lean correspondence) of mgubi's author draft PR #257 at `fe5ec7a333e13a09c07f1e9a955581a179412c07`: the new paragraphs "The public family of this retained history" and "Conditional running consequence" in `manuscript/existence/public-run-binding.tex` (SHA-256 `392fbb29…7cde6f`). ADB991 did not author #257; disclosure: ADB991 authored G02 (#138) and C16 revision 1 (#165). This review renews no G02/C16 fingerprint.

**Verdict: no required change.** Each asserted identity matches the pinned definitions: level block ℓ_m = L_{J(m+1)} (`YM.RG.Calendar.Fits.sameFactor`), D_N and a_N = D_N^{-1} = e^{-s_N} (`YM.Schedule.denominator/a/scale/scale_succ`), β^pub_{N,p} = β^R_{N,p,N} (`YM.Family.beta`, `YangMills.wilsonFamily`), and the insertion `cylinder v = initial(terminal.symm v)`, with a_N^{-d} and the colour-count dilation `Frame.scaled` (`YM.Source.TransferData.cylinder`, `YM.Source.initial`, `YM.Labels.Frame.scaled`). The finite moments agree definitionally (`YangMills.moment_eq`). The m=N specialization of `prop:uniform-extraction` correctly gives `ex-running-input` with N_0 chosen before ∀p, matching `zeroUp_bound`/`regular`. The running hypothesis has exactly the form of `YM.RG.History.Running`, with slope `slopeConstant = 2 b0` (`b0_normalizes`).

Minor points:
- N1: A^R_{d,N,p} clashes with A_j(L) in the same section; other chapters write X_{N,p}.
- N2: β^pub = β^R_{N,p,N} holds by definition; `Selected.starts` instead identifies the two *laws*.
- N3: ϑ_N is not defined in the passage. In the source it is `Calendar.threshold`, hatβ^{-1/2}·exp((log log hatβ)^2).

Optional O1: in the source, `Running` is a field of `History.Selected`. The manuscript's producer is the subsection "The running-coupling estimate" of `surviving-interval-shooting.tex`. Citing it needs two identifications: its level-indexed L_i must be the present ℓ_i, and its slope s_G must equal 2b_0(G). The second is G02's O1 and is still open, so the conditional phrasing is correct as written.
